title: A fixed pseudo-coherent cohomology sheaf is quasi-coherent
statement: Let Y be a scheme and E a pseudo-coherent object of D(O_Y). For every integer n, the n-th cohomology sheaf of E is quasi-coherent.

proof.text: Choose around each point a bounded-above finite-free model supplied by pseudo-coherence. In the chosen degree, its cohomology is the quotient of the kernel of one differential by the image of the preceding differential. Finite free terms are quasi-coherent, and the kernel and cokernel/image closure results make this quotient quasi-coherent; the local identifications glue by locality of quasi-coherence.
